tips.text: Finish the mandatory bounty objective every run; failing it forfeits the whole reward roll.
Run the bounties for Lanthorns while you chase the blueprint, since the same table pays them.
Pick up the two Argon Crystals last, right before crafting, because they decay.
Farm Alternox for Mastery only; threads call it one of the weakest rifles for its rank.
Expect a long dry streak; one player ran over 120 bounties without the blueprint.
